name: Dynamo#12463: UCX_NET_DEVICES unset causes garbage tokens in P/D serving
notes: Critical silent failure: vLLM disaggregated serving over InfiniBand returns garbage tokens when UCX_NET_DEVICES is unset. HTTP 200 with well-formed response but corrupt content. Setting UCX_NET_DEVICES=mlx5_0:1 fixes it. Affects 2-node H200 cluster with NixlConnector. No error surfaced to client. Demonstrates multi-GPU/NVLink silent failure.
